title: All cheapest routes
brief: Find cheapest routes without discarding equal-cost alternatives.
instructions: Enumerate simple directed routes from 1 to 5 with at most four edges. Return every path attaining minimum total minutes. Sort paths as text.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes from_id,to_id,minutes from route_edges without solving all cheapest routes.

hints.text: Find the minimum cost after enumerating bounded simple routes.
Filter destination routes against their shared minimum rather than taking one arbitrary row.
Both 1>2>4>5 and 1>3>4>5 cost 25 minutes in the boundary.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT ((SELECT minutes FROM route_edges WHERE from_id = 1 AND to_id = 2) + (SELECT minutes FROM route_edges WHERE from_id = 2 AND to_id = 4) + (SELECT minutes FROM route_edges WHERE from_id = 4 AND to_id = 5))::VARCHAR || '/' || ((SELECT minutes FROM route_edges WHERE from_id = 1 AND to_id = 3) + (SELECT minutes FROM route_edges WHERE from_id = 3 AND to_id = 4) + (SELECT minutes FROM route_edges WHERE from_id = 4 AND to_id = 5))::VARCHAR
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: both four-node paths cost 25 minutes
